thread:
cs-jordan: Heads-up — we have multiple customers reporting 503s on hosted inference during long streaming/embed calls. Started ~2026-03-16T02:12Z. Symptoms: p95 latency spikes then 503s, container restarts. Customer samples: req id req_0a1b2c3d, req_9f8e7d6c.

mike-oncall: Investigating. Are these correlated to a deploy? Any common model or region? :eyes:

cs-jordan: All in us-west1. Most hits against model variant rdx-open-13b-8bit (recent quant swap last night). A few against rdx-open-13b-int8. Appears during very long context requests (examples around ~120k chars / ~20k tokens).

infra-lucas: Pod logs show abrupt segfaults and OOMs. Early snippet from pod runner log: 
```
[2026-03-16T02:13:40Z] runner ERROR: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x00007fabcde
[2026-03-16T02:13:40Z] runtime: cudaGetLastError: out of memory
[2026-03-16T02:13:40Z] gpu_monitor: GPU0 mem 31000/32000 MB
```

sara-ml: Interesting — quant swap + long KV cache growth could push memory over for that variant. Did the runtime pick a different kernel path?

infra-lucas: Kernel path changed on deploy: fused-attn enabled for long-sequence codepath. Deploy bot shows rollout 2026-03-16T01:45 with dynbatch cap increase to 64.

deploy-bot: release rdx-runtime@2026.03.16-0145 rolled to 50% traffic (config: fused_attn=true, dynbatch_max=64, prefetch=true)

mike-oncall: If fused_attn + bigger dynbatch + long prompt => KV cache blow-up. We should throttle dynbatch for 13B-8bit until we confirm. Quick mitigation: rollback fused_attn flag for this model or lower dynbatch_max to 16.

infra-lucas: Took a snapshot of NVIDIA metrics from the affected host: 
```
$ nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv
pid, used_memory
4521, 31014 MiB (python /opt/infer/runner)
```
Core dump shows a segfault in the attention kernel. Stack trace excerpt: 
```
#0  0x7f9ab... in torch::cuda::impl::something
#1  0x7f8cd... in fused_attention::run
#2  0x55aa... in Runner::generate
```

sara-ml: Can we reproduce locally with a synthetic long prompt? I can run a stress script to send a 20k-token prompt and watch mem.

cs-jordan: CS asked for repro + customer sample JSON (redacted). They sent a sample that includes many concatenated documents (~450KB). Provided request-id req_9f8e7d6c.

mike-oncall: Action plan: 1) throttle dynbatch for rdx-open-13b-8bit to 8, 2) temporarily pin traffic to rdx-open-13b-int8 (less likely to use fused path), 3) collect full coredump + nvcrash logs, 4) ask ML to run reproduce script against canary host.

infra-lucas: I've applied dynbatch_max=8 for pods in pool hosted-us-west1-13b-8 and pinned canary to int8 variant. Rolling now.

billing-amy: Heads up — customers hit heavy retry loops; we saw a billing spike for the last hour on tokens due to retries. Need to flag for CS credits if the incident persists.

cs-jordan: I'll open a support ticket and ask customers for full request bodies and timestamps. Also notifying accounts team.

mike-oncall: Repro steps for ML: 
1) Checkout runtime tag rdx-runtime@2026.03.16-0145
2) Start canary pod with fused_attn=true, dynbatch_max=64
3) Send POST /v1/streams with payload similar to sample (attach file) and stream mode enabled.

sara-ml: Running reproduce now against a spare GPU (driver 525.85). If I hit OOM/segfault, I'll capture coredump and run `gdb -c core /opt/infer/runner` and upload stack.

infra-lucas: For forensic logs, collect: `kubectl logs -c runner $POD --since=2h`, `kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=$POD`, `journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced --since '2 hours ago'`, and `gsutil cp /var/log/nvcrash/* gs://redwood-incidents/6129876543/`.

mike-oncall: Short-term mitigation is in. If we still get 503s after dynbatch cap, next step is rollback the runtime release to previous stable before 01:45.

cs-jordan: Customer-facing note draft: "We're investigating intermittent 503 errors affecting long-context requests in us-west1. Our engineers are actively reproducing and have applied a conservative batching cap. We'll follow up with a remediation ETA and credits if requests retried." cc: @accounts @support.

billing-amy: Please add request ids and affected timestamps to the billing ticket. I'll prepare a credit estimate template.

sara-ml: Repro update: after ~3 attempts with 20k-token prompt, I can reproduce an OOM that leads to SIGSEGV in fused attention. Uploading coredump + minimal repro script to gs://redwood-incidents/6129876543/repro.tar.gz

infra-lucas: Received repro. Will run it in sandbox with instrumentation (cuda-memcheck, nvprof). Also checking if our fused-attn kernel has a known regression on driver 525.x.

mike-oncall: Triage notes: probable cause = fused-attn regression triggered by long KV growth + higher dynbatch. Mitigation = cap dynbatch / rollback fused-attn; Remediation = patch kernel or fallback codepath with stricter prefetch.

cs-jordan: I'll post updates to customers and mark this thread for follow-up after ML/Infra confirm root cause. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
